note: The crawl frontier. Each lane lists concrete starting points. Iterations mark targets explored in state.json and may append new targets discovered along the way. A target is never permanently done — re-explore after `recheck_after_days`.

instruments.objective: Find policy instruments missing from data/policies.json, amendments or status changes to instruments already in it, and working official URLs for the nine records still marked Unverified.
instruments.makes_dashboard: More advanced — a directory that is incomplete or stale is the single biggest credibility risk.

targets.label: PTA laws, regulations, and policy directives
PTA live regulations index — the real dated listing page
National Assembly bills passed — as-passed texts, authoritative for new Acts
MoITT policies and downloads
National Assembly bills index
Senate of Pakistan bills and passed legislation
Pakistan Code — consolidated federal statutes
State Bank of Pakistan circulars, PSD/BPRD regulations
SECP regulatory frameworks and digital-finance circulars
National CERT advisories, frameworks, and rules
PEMRA rules and directives touching online media
NADRA regulations on identity and data sharing
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab — passed acts
Provincial Assembly of Sindh — passed acts
Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa — acts
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan — acts
Hunt working official URLs for the nine Unverified records
Supreme Court and Islamabad High Court judgments altering the effect of listed instruments

datasets.objective: Find quantitative datasets that can be layered onto policy records so a reader sees real-world numbers next to the legal text — connectivity, payments, shutdowns, takedowns, exports, prices.
datasets.makes_dashboard: More advanced and more nuanced — turns a static legal directory into something that shows whether a policy changed anything.

SBP quarterly Payment Systems Review — digital transaction volumes

ITU DataHub — Pakistan connectivity and affordability indicators

Access Now #KeepItOn shutdown tracker — Pakistan entries

Meta Transparency Center — Pakistan content restrictions
PSEB / SBP IT and IT-enabled services export figures
Freedom House — Freedom on the Net, Pakistan scores over time
PTA quarterly tracking of the top mobile hybrid and data-only bundle tariffs

plain-language.objective: Find material that lets a non-lawyer understand what each instrument means for them: plain-language patterns, glossary definitions, who-is-affected framing, and comparable laws in other countries for orientation.
plain-language.makes_dashboard: Easier to understand — this is the lane that decides whether an ordinary person can use the site at all.

targets.label: Plain-language writing standards and readability targets for public-interest legal content
GOV.UK content design patterns for explaining rules to citizens
PTA consumer-facing complaint and rights pages — citizen-level framing
SBP consumer protection and digital-payments guidance for the public
EU GDPR as a reference point for Pakistan's data-protection bill
India DPDP Act 2023 — closest regional analogue
Exemplar policy explainers that everyday readers actually use, for structure and tone
Definitions for the legal/technical jargon appearing in the 51 summaries
Established Urdu terminology for core digital-rights and telecom concepts

context.objective: Find sourced analysis, litigation, and civil-society critique that populates the `controversy` field and adds nuance the official text omits.
context.makes_dashboard: More nuanced — official summaries alone read like the state's own account of itself.
